subject: Your SoulPlan streak is still alive
preview_text: Something changed in the app since you last opened it. One tap could bring back the spark.
body_paragraphs: It's been 48 days since you and your partner last opened SoulPlan. I know life gets loud. But here's the thing: your streak counter is still frozen, not broken. That pause you took? It's safe, no shame, no reset. The app remembers every dinner, every laugh, every quiet night you already shared together.

But something changed while you were away. The Tonight's Date card on your home screen now learns faster. It watched what moods you both gravitated toward—cozy, playful, healing—and adjusted. Your next tap on a single mood won't just pull a random idea. It pulls the idea your partner will smile at, the one that makes them say "you remembered." The data from couples who use this feature within their first 24 hours? They plan 4x more dates over the next month. That's not a coincidence. That's the app working for you, not against you.

Open the app. Find the card waiting on your home screen. One tap on a mood, and tonight is planned in 30 seconds. No scrolling. No decision fatigue. Just a moment that says "I see you." Your partner deserves that tonight, not someday.
Tap the card now. Your memory timeline is waiting for its next page. P.S. The anniversary jar sent a gentle reminder last week—the app knows what you almost forgot.
